name: My views
description: Your pull requests and the reviews you owe, live in the sidebar, in the order you keep them.

scopes.integration:github:read: Read your pull requests with the connected GitHub account.
scopes.agent_chat:read: Look again as soon as one of your agent chats changes (it may have opened a PR).
scopes.net:api.github.com: Read public pull requests for the login you type, when GitHub is not connected.
scopes.storage:local: Keep the order you move your pull requests into, and your login.
scopes.actions:run: Open a pull request in a browser tab when you click it.
